ai_summary: AGI has announced a Board Meeting for October 28, 2026, primarily to approve its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory disclosure under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and the document itself contains no red flags. The release of these upcoming financial results will be the material event for investors, providing key insights into the company's recent operational and financial performance.
